description: Na₂Mn₃O₇ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.29 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.69 Å. There are three inequivalent Mn sites. In the first Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-2.00 Å. In the second Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.84-2.00 Å. In the third Mn site, Mn is bonded to six O atoms to form edge-sharing MnO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Mn-O bond distances ranging from 1.83-1.99 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Mn atoms to form distorted ONa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Mn₃ square pyramids, corners with five ONaMn₃ trigonal pyramids, and  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Mn₃ square pyramid. In the second O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Mn atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Mn atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Mn atoms. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to one Na and three Mn atoms to form ONaMn₃ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one ONa₂Mn₃ square pyramid, corners with two equivalent ONa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids, edges with two equivalent ONa₂Mn₃ square pyramids, and edges with three ONaMn₃ trigonal pyramids. In the sixth O site, O is bonded to two Na and two Mn atoms to form distorted ONa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Mn₃ square pyramids, corners with three equivalent ONa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Mn₃ square pyramid, and edges with two equivalent ONaMn₃ trigonal pyramids. In the seventh O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and three Mn atoms to form distorted ONa₂Mn₃ square pyramids that share corners with five ONa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Mn₃ square pyramid, and edges with four ONa₂Mn₂ trigonal pyramids.
